graph-rules.value: All enforced in `validatePipelineGraph` and the editor; a human step saves with `agentProfileId: null`, empty subagents, and no start/Set-as-start affordance.

comment-rules.value: As stated; blank/whitespace Return is rejected by the route and disabled in the UI; Accept with a blank comment is allowed.

feedback-trust.value: Yes — a dedicated trusted section, stored on the human history record and carried on the pending launch/arrival, never folded into a `Handoff` that `composeStepPrompt` fences.

step-cap.value: They are recorded in `history` and shown in progress, but do not increment `stepCount`; entering a gate is never blocked by the step cap.

visual.value: As stated; the pending gate uses the same info highlight on the canvas and in the panel header; the run status chip reads "Review".

editor-add.value: As stated; switching an agent step to human clears its agent/subagents; switching back to agent starts unbound; `deleteStep` never promotes a human step to start.

no-third-action.value: Accept follows the outgoing edges and only finishes when there are none; Return loops with a required comment; abandoning the run stays Restart/archive/delete.

manual-advance.value: As stated; the panel shows "no handoff" for that arrival; the gate is otherwise identical.

notify.value: As stated; the notification is deduped per run+gate seq; clicking it opens the run view with the gate selected; the status chip still reads "Review".
